scope: Public-data adaptation of post-game snapshot-to-future-rating regression. Twelve three-minute snapshots and six features, OpenSkill five-future-observed-match proxy, returning-player-conditioned sample, not the original 115-feature verified-novice TrueSkill task. Target availability purges train/validation examples. Only 21 test examples meet the limited-observed-history subgroup; no novice effectiveness claim.
